facility: Florida's Turnpike System and FDOT toll facilities
rate_model_note: Flat amount per mainline plaza and per tolled interchange (ramp gantries), by axle count. All-electronic; no time-of-day pricing. Each row keeps its table's own effective date.
valid_from_note: The newest table's effective date. A row with an older 'effective' date is priced from that date (GantrySet.rowStart); a row without one only from this date.
reprices_on: per regional schedule; FTE indexes rates to CPI (typically 1 July)
source_note: The six regional 'Toll Rates for Florida's Turnpike System and FDOT Toll Facilities' PDFs linked from the rates page. Where a plaza is shared with CFX (Beachline West, Dallas) only the Turnpike/FDOT portion is listed; CFX's portion is on the CFX card.
payment_premium_note: TOLL-BY-PLATE is what a vehicle without SunPass (or an interoperable transponder) pays; FTE also adds a $2.50 administrative charge per monthly invoice (not estimated).
